rows.location: tools/figure_sweep.js collisions(), the block 'A plotted segment drawn outside the plot area is clipped away' (lines 94-109); tools/page_smoke.py docstring ('no plotted segment may lie outside the plot area')
rows.evidence: The new check compares each `.plot line.line` with the clipPath rect and fails only when the whole segment lies more than 0.5 px outside it. chart.js plot() draws that clip rect at y = margin.top - 4 with height inner.h + 8, so it is 4 px taller than the plot area at top and bottom, and a segment between the clip edge and the plot edge, or one whose centre is clipped by less than 0.5 px, passes. Test: I served a copy of course/ with the df84c85 figures-L05.js (y domain [floor, max(t) + 0.8]) and the current tools/figure_sweep.js and rendered the round-5 failure states (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-quant-phd/cdd15252-4236-59f9-8fa8-e63e41e1dc0d/scratchpad/verify6-L05-L06/scripts/seed_probe.py, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-quant-phd/cdd15252-4236-59f9-8fa8-e63e41e1dc0d/scratchpad/verify6-L05-L06/work/old_regress.jsonl, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-quant-phd/cdd15252-4236-59f9-8fa8-e63e41e1dc0d/scratchpad/verify6-L05-L06/out/old_regress.txt, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-quant-phd/cdd15252-4236-59f9-8fa8-e63e41e1dc0d/scratchpad/verify6-L05-L06/shots/old/): at 360 px seeds 397, 619 and 874 draw the critical-value line at y = 11.17, 11.54 and 10.15 px, above the plot's top edge at 14 px and the y axis's top; at 1280 px seed 397 draws it at 9.55 px, centre outside the clip top at 10 px (most of its 2.25 px stroke clipped away), and 619 at 10.12 px. collisions() reports nothing for any of these five states; only seed 874 at 1280 px (7.94 px) is reported, and the existing 'leaves its SVG' text check already caught that one. So the check does not do what page_smoke's docstring says, and it would not have caught 5 of the 6 round-5 failure states; the current StepM figure is unaffected (every segment inside the plot area in all my states, L05-fig-stepm-steps).
rows.fix: In tools/figure_sweep.js collisions(), test segments against the plot area, not the clip rectangle: take the clip rect and inset it by 4 px at top and bottom (chart.js plot() sets it to y = margin.top - 4, height = inner.h + 8), and push 'a plotted segment lies outside the plot area' when any part of a `.plot line.line` lies outside it by more than 0.5 px (min/max of y1, y2 and of x1, x2 against the area), not only when the whole segment does. Add a regression test that serves the df84c85 stepmSteps y domain [floor, max(t) + 0.8] at seeds 397, 619 and 874 at 360 and 1280 px and requires collisions() to report the segment in all six states, and re-run page_smoke --all.
